text:
Watch of builds/echo/0004 (be84884, template agent@afb9ec0fb292, v5) in a copy outside the repository, 2026-11-14, on the person's words to this session "네, 열어 주세요" [yes, open it]. Same setting and the same brief as the watch of echo/0003 (20261112-meta-macbook-20261112-1-8): the copy held the bundle only (29 files, hash equal to the build card's bundle_sha256, nothing of another project above it), a fresh session on claude-sonnet-5-5 at medium, asked for task 001 and for replay item rp-001 made by its own call.

What it did. By its report: one instruction file in its context, the bundle's CLAUDE.md; it loaded run-skill only, before the call of rp-001, and used the section "When the task needs a tool and no library skill calls it" and library/index.md, which says there is no library skill; it loaded neither classify-knowledge nor choose-session-level and says why (no value entered its report from outside a run, and it started no subagent). Checked by me against the copy: it wrote nothing at all, the copy equals the build file for file (diff -rq, exit 0), and no file of its own is in the application's notes folders. It made the call of rp-001 by piping the input to the runner of tools; on my rerun the same command printed message "replay", length 6, exit 0, which is what the item expects. On my rerun task 001 printed "gate: self-check ok" (exit 0), "replay: 2 item(s), 2 as expected, 0 not; OK" (exit 0), "gates: interface pass, scientific undecided; overall undecided" (exit 1), as it reported. The repository was not touched; validate.py --bundle on the build prints VERDICT PASS, failed=0, at head 3612735.

What v5 shows here: the start task's sentence was read as meant (the failure status of the task validator with undecided is expected and is not a failure of the bundle), and the session did not look for a folder named runs that is not there; it says the session makes it on first write. It found no fault in the bundle's text. It did not open tools/echo/tool.json, which run-skill points to for the inputs; it took the input from the replay item, which is enough for this item. Its one failed command was its own (it passed a command and its flag as one word, exit 2, and ran it again).

Unlike the session in rheo-fixture/0003, this one wrote nothing outside its folder, though it was opened the same way; so that limit of the rheometer watch is of that session, not of every session opened from mine.

Limits as before: one model and effort, a mock tool, I reran its commands and did not see the text of every command it ran, and the copy is in my session's scratch folder and is not a record.

Nothing is asked to land. For the task card: template v5 is now watched standing alone on both fixtures, echo/0004 and rheo-fixture/0003; the runner of skills running a library skill is still watched on the rheometer fixture alone.
